==Changes==
* Zeroes have been removed from item links. They now look like: |cff0070dd|Hitem:128955::::::::99:577::11::::|h[The Spider Queen's Veil]|h|r
* The way nameplates are created has changed completely.
** New addon: Blizzard_Nameplates
** New events: {{api|t=e|NAME_PLATE_CREATED}}, {{api|t=e|NAME_PLATE_UNIT_ADDED}}, {{api|t=e|NAME_PLATE_UNIT_REMOVED}}
** Functions like GetNumNamePlateMotionTypes and GetNameplateFrames have been moved to a new C_Nameplates table.
***{{api|C_NamePlate.GetNamePlateForUnit}},
***{{api|C_NamePlate.GetNamePlateSizes}},
***{{api|C_NamePlate.GetNamePlates}},
***{{api|C_NamePlate.GetNumNamePlateMotionTypes}},
***{{api|C_NamePlate.SetNamePlateSizes}},
* The [[UIOBJECT Texture|Texture]] method [[API Texture SetTexture|Texture:SetTexture]](R, G, B[, A]) no longer works properly in many cases. Use the new method [[API Texture SetColorTexture|Texture:SetColorTexture]] instead.
* The [[UIOBJECT Texture|Texture]] method [[API Texture SetTexCoord|Texture:SetTexCoord]] no longer works properly for values greater than 1. This was previously used for horizontal and (especially) vertical tiling. For now, use the optional parameters in the method [[API Texture SetTexture|Texture:SetTexture]](texturePath[, horizTile[, vertTile]]) instead to tile textures.  Alternatively, [[API Texture SetVertTile|Texture:SetVertTile]](<bool>) and [[API Texture SetHorizTile|Texture:SetHorizTile]](<bool>) might be the intended replacements for this behavior.
* The [[UIOBJECT Texture|Texture]] method [[API Texture SetToFileData|Texture:SetToFileData]] has been removed and is now handled by [[API Texture SetTexture|Texture:SetTexture]] instead.
* [[API GetSpellInfo|GetSpellInfo]](spellid) now returns [[fileID]] for its 3rd return instead if iconPath.
* The deprecated animation method [[API Alpha SetChange|Alpha:SetChange]] has been removed. Use [[API Alpha SetFromAlpha|Alpha:SetFromAlpha]] and/or [[API Alpha SetToAlpha|Alpha:SetToAlpha]] instead.
* [[API GetInboxItem|GetInboxItem]] now returns the itemID between name and itemTexture:  name, itemID, itemTexture, count, quality, canUse = [[API GetInboxItem|GetInboxItem]](index, itemIndex)
* [[API GetSendMailItem|GetSendMailItem]] now returns the itemID between name and itemTexture:  name, itemID, itemTexture, count, quality = [[API GetSendMailItem|GetSendMailItem]](sendMailIndex)
* [[API GetNumDungeonMapLevels|GetNumDungeonMapLevels]] now returns an array of level numbers. To get the count of levels, get the length of the returned array
* [[API GetMapLandmarkInfo|GetMapLandmarkInfo]] now returns a type integer as its first return value, before name which used to be the first return value
* Frame type [[XML/Minimap|Minimap]] are no longer creatable by [[API CreateFrame|CreateFrame]] and will be ignored in xml files for 3rd party addons.
* [[API GameTooltip SetTradeSkillItem|GameTooltip:SetTradeSkillItem]](tradeItemIndex[, reagentIndex]) replaced by [[API GameTooltip SetRecipeReagentItem|GameTooltip:SetRecipeReagentItem]](recipeID, reagentIndex).
* [[API GetQuestLogRewardSpell|GetQuestLogRewardSpell]](rewardSpellIndex) requires rewardSpellIndex parameter now
* GarrisonUI API have been updated and multiple of the C_Garrison.* now requires a LE_* filter and new return values have been added.
* Some Mountjournal Functions got renamed
** {{api|C_MountJournal.GetMountInfo}} has been renamed to {{api|C_MountJournal.GetMountInfoByID}}
** {{api|C_MountJournal.GetMountInfoExtra}} has been renamed to {{api|C_MountJournal.GetMountInfoExtraByID}}
** {{api|C_MountJournal.Summon}} has been renamed to {{api|C_MountJournal.SummonByID}}

==Removals==
* Glyph handling: CastGlyph, SetGlyph, GetGlyphInfo, etc.
* GetInventoryItemGems and GetContainerItemGems (but gem information is still apparently extractable from the itemString)
* GetQuestLogRewardTalents
* API regarding in-field visibility changes to helms and cloaks:  ShowHelm, ShowCloak, ShowingHelm, ShowingCloak
* Functions regarding defunct stats [[Multistrike]] and Amplify
* Frame method: [[API Frame AllowAttributeChanges|Frame:AllowAttributeChanges]]()
* Event UNIT_COMBO_POINTS (streamlined into UNIT_POWER)
* CVar [[CVar floatingCombatTextComboPoints|floatingCombatTextComboPoints]] (streamlined into [[CVar floatingCombatTextEnergyGains]])
* [[API Model GetModel|Model:GetModel()]] has been replaced by [[API Model GetModelFileID|Model:GetModelFileID()]]
